python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, re
from collections import defaultdict
p='/work/b3_supercon_data.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p)
bounds=dict(O=.697674,Cu=.454545,Ba=.333333,Sr=.285714,Y=.4,Ca=.272727,La=.78,Bi=.521978,Fe=.502513,Nb=.98,C=.972,Pr=.265043,As=.5,B=1,Pb=.5,Ce=.28,Mo=1,V=.9918,Zn=1,Ni=.6)
def parse(s):
    counts=defaultdict(float)
    matches=list(re.finditer(r'([A-Z][a-z]?)([0-9]*\.?[0-9]*)',s))
    assert ''.join(m.group() for m in matches)==s
    for m in matches:
        counts[m[1]]+=float(m[2]) if m[2] else 1.
    total=sum(counts.values())
    return {el:v/total for el,v in counts.items()}
parsed=df.composition.map(parse)
feasible=parsed.map(lambda x: set(x)<=set(bounds) and all(v<=bounds[k]+1e-6 for k,v in x.items()))
print('Rows:',len(df),'Feasible rows (1e-6 tolerance for rounded bounds):',feasible.sum())
print('\nHighest feasible observations:')
print(df[feasible].nlargest(12,'target').to_string(index=False))
print('\nTop overall observations:')
print(df.nlargest(8,'target').to_string(index=False))
i=df[feasible].target.idxmax()
x=parsed[i]
print('\nBest feasible normalized fractions:',x)
print('Sum:',sum(x.values()))
print('Strict bound compliance:',all(x.get(k,0)<=v for k,v in bounds.items()))
print('Final:',', '.join(f'{el}={x.get(el,0):g}' for el in bounds))
PY
